glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – four dots, perhaps three grains of sand (see 沙), to indicate "a few, a little". Phonetically borrowed from 小 (“small”), which is depicted by three dots. Unrelated to 步 (and hence 歲), in which the lower component is the stylization of a foot.
senses: [shǎo] few; little in number; less; not many
[shào] later in a sequence; younger; youngest
